prompt: A long 85mm lens low across a roulette table, full front: a white-haired croupier of about sixty-eight, clean-shaven, pouched eyes, black dinner jacket, chest-up and sharp, the black lacquered wheel out of focus in the near foreground. Behind him an upstairs gaming room is breaking up in a raid: gamblers in evening clothes running away from camera, a card table on its side, chips bouncing, banknotes thrown high and filling the air under a crystal chandelier. An emerald shaded lamp hangs over the table and its light bounces off the baize onto his mouth and chin. Violet light pours through a tall window behind, edging the falling money. The lacquer rim mirrors the chandelier as a line of bright points. Thanks.
